Mining Pool.methodology: Phase 1 emits 575K esLBR over 7 days. Phase 2 uses the max emission rate of 126,277 esLBR/day until the 55M allocation is exhausted. All esLBR is assumed to convert to LBR with a 30-day linear vest.
